description: Why is an ad squad not spending? (read-only) For each ACTIVE ad squad (or the one you name): did it show anything in the last days, and if not, what stops it: a paused campaign, a schedule that has not started or has ended, no ads or none approved, no budget, a missing pixel, an account that is not active. Snap's own delivery status is passed through. Use when the dashboard shows active ad squads but zero spend. On a big account pass campaign_id (or adsquad_id): without either it checks a sample of ACTIVE ad squads under the active campaigns, not everything.

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

campaign_id.description: Campaign id. Get it from snap_list_campaigns.

days.description: How many whole days back to look, counted from the start of today in SNAP_REPORT_UTC_OFFSET.

name: snap_delivery_check
